## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 6, 2026 - Aug 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Viajera 27_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "Don’t accept free trial! You are not able to cancel via the app and you will be charged for a year membership. I’ve tried multiple attempts to reach customer service with no response. Would not trust this company based on that alone. Very upsetting."
            2. _Merz1977_, Aug 6, 2026, 1/5: "I canceled the subscription on July 13th and the app has tried to charge almost every other day since then. Please let me know how I can stop this!"
            3. _Sidecarcritter_, Aug 9, 2026, 2/5: "This app is way too expensive unfortunately. $16 a month… not doable."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 24, 2026 - Aug 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _mo4958589594_, Jan 24, 2026, 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"
            2. _Edward 1988_, Aug 6, 2026, 5/5: "It’s a good app. Good at tracking and recommending. However, there’s a glitch when recording sets of exercises. Sometimes I’ll be in the middle of a workout and suddenly the app forgets 4-5 sets I just did. This happens maybe once every 15-20 workouts. For the money we pay, shouldn’t have basic bugs like this"
<!--/ir-theme-->
